lines.trans: The shashlik is simply great, it melts right in the mouth!
Thank you very much, I tried very hard today.
Kostya, and why are you not eating anything?
Thank you, I simply do not want shashlik.
Kostik, just try it, even I ate a piece!
Nastya, what are you saying, you are a vegetarian!
For the sake of the family I am ready for anything today.
Go on, try at least one piece.
In my opinion, this meat is dry and not tasty at all.
I do not want to eat his shashlik!
Kostya, you are behaving like a little child!
Well then, men, shall we have a quiet talk now?

examples.trans: And the very next day he took out an insurance policy.

examples.text: Судя по его глазам, он не забыл.
examples.trans: Judging by his eyes, he did not forget.

examples.text: Он просто вообще об этом не знал!
examples.trans: He simply did not know about it at all!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are leading, taking', paired with 'повести'.

examples.text: Вот этот отель весь принадлежит ей!
examples.trans: This entire hotel belongs to her!

examples.text: Нет, не слишком, ведь это инвестиция.
examples.trans: No, not too much, because it is an investment.

examples.text: Ах ты бессовестный негодяй, я тебя убью!
examples.trans: Oh you shameless scoundrel, I will kill you!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'themselves', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я четыре года назад порезал себе палец.
examples.trans: Four years ago I cut my finger.

examples.text: Да ты лучше себе сразу голову сломай!
examples.trans: You might as well break your own head right away!

examples.text: Я тебя умоляю, веди себя тихо!
examples.trans: I beg you, behave quietly!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'how', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мы скидываемся по тысяче рублей, как обычно.
examples.trans: We are chipping in a thousand rubles each, as usual.

examples.text: Я же вчера сказал, больше никаких встреч.
examples.trans: I told you yesterday, no more meetings.

examples.text: Сеня, как думаешь, что Кате подарить?
examples.trans: Senya, what do you think I should give Katya?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('small').

examples.text: Костя, ты ведёшь себя как маленький ребёнок!
examples.trans: Kostya, you are behaving like a little child!

examples.text: Где наш маленький Стёпка, он ещё в доме?
examples.trans: Where is our little Styopka, is he still in the house?

examples.text: Маленький дом.
examples.trans: A small house.

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'child' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Костя, ты ведёшь себя как маленький ребёнок!
examples.trans: Kostya, you are behaving like a little child!

examples.text: Это мой ребёнок.
examples.trans: This is my child.

examples.text: Ребёнок спит.
examples.trans: The child is asleep.

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'lads, guys' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Тогда твой муж будет очень недоволен!
examples.trans: Then your husband will be very displeased!

examples.text: Ну что, мужики, теперь спокойно поговорим?
examples.trans: Well then, men, shall we have a quiet talk now?

examples.text: Ты же мужчина, ты должен меня понять!
examples.trans: You are a man, you must understand me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'now', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ну что, мужики, теперь спокойно поговорим?
examples.trans: Well then, men, shall we have a quiet talk now?

examples.text: А я теперь человек серьёзный и женатый.
examples.trans: And I am a serious and married man now.

examples.text: Не понял, я что, денег теперь не получу?
examples.trans: I do not get it, will I not receive the money now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Так что давай спокойно пойдём в дом.
examples.trans: So let us go into the house calmly.

examples.text: Ну что, мужики, теперь спокойно поговорим?
examples.trans: Well then, men, shall we have a quiet talk now?

examples.text: Вы спокойно всё сделаете.
examples.trans: You'll do everything calmly.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'говорить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'talk', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.text: Ну что, мужики, теперь спокойно поговорим?
examples.trans: Well then, men, shall we have a quiet talk now?

examples.text: Поговори с ним.
examples.trans: Talk to him.

examples.text: Нам надо поговорить.
examples.trans: We need to talk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Отойди, ты мешаешь мне сейчас сосредоточиться.
examples.trans: Step back, you are keeping me from concentrating right now.

examples.text: Разрешите мне проводить вас сейчас наверх?
examples.trans: Allow me to escort you upstairs right now?

examples.text: Сейчас я их быстро помирю.
examples.trans: I will reconcile them quickly right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'their', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Понимаешь, у нас с ней всё очень сложно.
examples.trans: You see, everything is very complicated between her and me.

examples.text: Уходи прочь и больше мне не звони!
examples.trans: Go away and do not call me anymore!

examples.text: Они строят центр.
examples.trans: They are building a centre.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Сделай быстро вкусный кофе даме и мне.
examples.trans: Quickly make a delicious coffee for the lady and me.

examples.text: Скажи быстрее, чего тебе от меня надо?
examples.trans: Tell me quickly, what do you want from me?

examples.text: Быстро спрячься за эту колонну!
examples.trans: Quickly hide behind this column!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мирить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'will reconcile'.

examples.text: Понятно, что их надо быстро помирить.
examples.trans: Clearly, one must reconcile them quickly.

examples.text: Когда-нибудь ты захочешь помириться со своим папой.
examples.trans: Someday you'll want to make peace with your dad.
